source.title: Optional upstream API supply: original outputs, model costs and evaluation support
source.body:
Hi Chutes team — I’m Yami from ToAPIs. This is a supplier-cooperation proposal, not a bug report.

Chutes operates a deployed inference/API platform with public API routing and chute request/response schemas. We prepared original outputs, exact parameters and a dated price sheet for an optional upstream evaluation:
https://github.com/ToAPIs-2025/lower-cost-chutes-upstream-toapis

Our international test Key currently quotes gpt-image-2 / 1K at $0.015/image and gpt-image-2.5-flare / 1K at $0.0225/image. Both amounts were confirmed by settled image receipts on October 29. The quotations were checked on October 30; the original settled media are reused October 29 examples, not native acceptance in your product or universal tariffs.

We can support an optional Provider with evaluation credits and hands-on parameter/debugging help, product/documentation sponsorship where useful, or supplementary upstream API supply for your own hosted service. Larger-volume terms can be discussed against your exact models, output specifications and expected demand. Your branding, customer billing and existing suppliers can stay in place.

This would be an explicitly external optional route if it fits your platform policy, not represented as miner-executed or TEE-attested inference.

Would the person responsible for image/video model sourcing be open to reviewing these options? We can follow your supplier process and support a test that addresses an actual requirement from your team.

Thank you,
YamiAnn — ToAPIs Team
yami@toapis.com

The former chutesai/chutes-api repository is archived. We are using this active official platform SDK repository to ask for the appropriate supplier-team channel; this is not a request to route miner workloads to an external API or to label it as attested execution.
